name: Geraldine Hakewill
bio: Geraldine Hakewill (born 13 July 1987 in Paris, France) is an Australian actress.

credits.title: The Rooster
credits.overview: When the body of his oldest friend is found buried in a shallow grave, Dan, a small-town cop, seeks answers from a volatile hermit who was the last person to see his friend alive. As Dan gets closer to the truth, he must confront his own personal demons and he discovers that hope can be found in unlikely places.

credits.title: Flotsam Jetsam

credits.title: Shadow / Self
credits.overview: Shadow / Self is a film project that combines dance, fashion and music to explore the darker side of the feminine psyche. A story of human struggle told with movement, beauty and light.

credits.overview: Unable to deal with life alone, Alex seeks her doppelganger in an attempt to find herself. When she meets Lex everything seems to be perfect, but what happens when life becomes a little too familiar?
